claims.claim: AM Intelligence placed a binding order for 20,000 Nvidia Rubin GPUs valued at around $4 billion to set up 70MW of capacity.
claims.episode_span: binding order for 20,000 Nvidia Rubin GPUs in a deal valued at around $4 billion to set up a 70MW capacity
claims.source_title: Greenko founders-backed AM Intelligence orders 20,000 Nvidia GPUs in $4 billion deal
claims.supporting_quote: Greenko founders-backed AM Intelligence (AMI) has placed a binding order for 20,000 Nvidia Rubin graphics processing units (GPUs) in a deal valued at around $4 billion to set up a 70MW capacity, according to two people aware of the development.

claims.claim: The Rubin order is described as driving a 100MW expansion across India and Malaysia and follows an August deal to deploy 9,000 GPUs in Hyderabad.
claims.episode_span: driving a 100MW expansion across India and Malaysia
claims.source_title: Greenko founders-backed AM Intelligence orders 20,000 Nvidia GPUs in $4 billion deal
claims.supporting_quote: These Nvidia Rubin GPUs will supply 70MW power, to drive a 100MW expansion across India and Malaysia despite global chip shortages. This follows an August deal to deploy 9,000 GPUs at its Hyderabad centre for cloud computing.

claims.claim: Sources say that once the order is deployed, AM Intelligence will operate the largest operational compute capacity in India by the second quarter of 2027, using Vera Rubin NVL72 GPUs described as more power-efficient than Blackwell.
claims.episode_span: largest operational compute capacity in India by the second quarter of 2027
claims.source_title: Greenko founders-backed AM Intelligence orders 20,000 Nvidia GPUs in $4 billion deal
claims.supporting_quote: Once this order is deployed, AM Intelligence will operate the largest operational compute capacity in India by the second quarter of 2027.

claims.claim: In January AMI signed an MoU with InvestUP for a 1GW AI hub by 2030 with $25 billion of cumulative investment, and separately plans another 300MW in 15 months for $20 billion.
claims.episode_span: A January memorandum of understanding with InvestUP, for a 1GW hub by 2030 and $25 billion
claims.source_title: Greenko founders-backed AM Intelligence orders 20,000 Nvidia GPUs in $4 billion deal
claims.supporting_quote: In January, the company signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with InvestUP, the Uttar Pradesh government's investment arm, at Davos to set up an AI hub with 1GW capacity by 2030 with a cumulative investment of $25 billion and deployment of 500,000 high-performance chips.

claims.claim: ASUS announced a 64 GB Ascent GX10 beside a 128 GB model, on the NVIDIA DGX Spark platform, and two systems can be clustered for 128 GB of pooled memory and around 1.7X throughput.
claims.episode_span: two systems can be clustered with the NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant for 128 GB of pooled memory and around 1.7X the throughput
claims.source_title: ASUS Announces New 64GB Configuration of the Ascent GX10
claims.supporting_quote: When workloads grow, two systems can be clustered with the NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant for 128 GB of pooled memory and around 1.7X the throughput.

claims.claim: Intel Xeon 6+ Clearwater Forest CPUs are now shipping in volume.
claims.episode_span: Intel’s Xeon 6+ Clearwater Forest CPUs are now shipping in volume
claims.source_title: Intel Xeon 6+ SKU List and Value Analysis: Clearwater Forest Runs Wide
claims.supporting_quote: With Intel's Xeon 6+ "Clearwater Forest" CPUs now shipping in volume, we are taking a look at the various SKU options among chips, and what configurations offer the best value for different needs

claims.claim: Synopsys's Dana Neustadter said the company has seen a major uptick in rad-hard fab process activity on newer nodes for orbital data centers, owing a lot of it to Golden Dome.
claims.episode_span: major uptick in activity for rad-hard fab processes, particularly on newer process nodes
claims.source_title: Extreme Environments Push Chips To Their Breaking Point
claims.supporting_quote: “We have seen a major uptick in activity for rad-hard fab processes, particularly in the new process nodes to support orbital data centers,” said Dana Neustadter, senior director of product management at Synopsys .

claims.claim: Gorilla has begun deliveries that could place more than 25,000 Nvidia GPUs in Yotta facilities, structured as about 5,110 B200 GPUs and 20,736 B300 cards, with the B300 phase valued at about $2.8 billion.
claims.episode_span: second phase covers 20,736 Nvidia B300 GPU cards
claims.source_title: Yotta’s Nvidia GPU push enters execution phase
claims.supporting_quote: The initial deployment comprises around 640 servers carrying about 5,110 Nvidia B200 GPUs, while the larger second phase covers 20,736 Nvidia B300 GPU cards.

claims.claim: The B300 completion target of September 30 has slipped, with remaining B200 phases due early or mid-October and B300 tranches of around 5,000 GPUs running from October through year-end.
claims.episode_span: B300 deliveries starting in October in tranches of around 5,000 GPUs and finishing by year-end
claims.source_title: Yotta’s Nvidia GPU push enters execution phase
claims.supporting_quote: Deliveries of the larger B300 deployment were expected to begin in October in tranches of around 5,000 GPUs and conclude by the end of the year.

claims.claim: A proposed 20-story Kansas City data center would occupy about 0.23 acres and a related ordinance is on hold until October 13.
claims.episode_span: a 20-story data center tower would occupy about 0.23 acres in downtown Kansas City, Missouri
claims.source_title: Vertical Data Centers Face Cost-Proximity Trade-Offs
claims.supporting_quote: Designed by storied Chicago architecture firm Skidmore, Owings & Merrill (SOM) for developer Revitalization Unlimited, the facility would occupy approximately 0.23 acres.

claims.claim: NERC figures cited in a Utility Dive sponsored piece put U.S. electricity consumption rising from 4,281 TWh in 2024 to 5,353 TWh by 2034, with more than 2 TW in interconnection queues by mid-2026 and nearly 200 GW of ERCOT large-load applications in the first quarter of 2026.
claims.episode_span: U.S. electricity consumption rising from 4,281 TWh in 2024 to 5,353 TWh by 2034
claims.source_title: Hidden capacity: The overlooked opportunity in North America’s race for power
claims.supporting_quote: According to NERC, the United States’ electricity consumption could rise from 4,281 TWh in 2024 to 5,353 TWh by 2034, 1 while other studies suggest demand growth could be even higher.

claims.claim: SK Hynix is reported to hold roughly 50 percent of global HBM revenue, is negotiating 2027 volumes and pricing, and had spent 30.9733 trillion won on buybacks, 73.74 percent of the program, as of September 30.
claims.episode_span: 30.9733 trillion won spent on buybacks, 73.74 percent of the announced program
claims.source_title: SK Hynix Balances AI Memory Roadmap Against Solidigm Financing Questions
claims.supporting_quote: Filings with the Seoul exchange as of September 30 show the company has spent 30.9733 trillion won repurchasing its own shares, completing 73.74 percent of its announced buyback program.

claims.claim: SK Hynix management has stated that no capital plan for Solidigm has been decided.
claims.episode_span: no capital plan for the subsidiary has been decided
claims.source_title: SK Hynix Balances AI Memory Roadmap Against Solidigm Financing Questions
claims.supporting_quote: Management has stated that no capital plan for the subsidiary has been decided, adding that any internal or external financing measure would first be assessed for its impact on existing shareholders and long-term corporate value.

claims.claim: SEC Co. has supplied HBM inspection equipment to Micron, with Samsung and SK inline orders described as imminent.
claims.episode_span: SEC Co. has supplied HBM inspection equipment to Micron
claims.source_title: SEC Co. Supplies HBM Inspection Equipment to Micron; Samsung, SK Inline Orders Imminent
claims.supporting_quote: SEC Co. Supplies HBM Inspection Equipment to Micron; Samsung, SK Inline Orders Imminent

claims.claim: INNO3D announced the AGS-6220V2 6U server with dual Intel Xeon 5th Gen Scalable processors, up to 32 DDR5 RDIMMs, eight PCIe Gen 5 x16 slots for NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, and four 2700 W redundant Titanium power supplies.
claims.episode_span: four 2700 W redundant Titanium power supplies
claims.source_title: INNO3D Announces 6U RTX PRO 6000BSE GPU Server
claims.supporting_quote: The system supports NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs across eight PCIe Gen 5 x16 slots, enabling accelerated AI, simulation, and data-intensive applications.
